ruleset: OD8 stable native generated lane-one tap notes
eligible_notes: each scheduled isolated lane-zero note whose visible_from_us is <= audit_end_us
primary_denominator: count of eligible notes, including no emitted DOWN
first_down: first non-repeat lane-zero DOWN with time_us >= this note's visible_from_us and time_us < next note's visible_from_us; for the last visible note, through audit_end_us inclusive
simultaneous_or_overlapping_cues: reject; Candidate 1 requires unique isolated lane-zero cue onsets with next visible_from_us > prior hit_us
before_first_cue: background action, excluded from all note numerators and extras
at_visible_onset: cue onset precedes action; DOWN belongs to the newly visible note
at_next_visible_onset: previous note closes as no_down or retains its existing first; DOWN belongs to new note
at_game_expiry: game expiry precedes action; DOWN remains scoped to current cue until next onset, and raw game disposition is preserved
same_time_actions: preserve raw game-event insertion order; only the first fresh DOWN is primary; REPEAT_DOWN is not a new press
signed_error_us: first_down_us minus immutable note hit_us; null presses retain signed error
success_rule: first DOWN exists and abs(signed_error_us) <= 73000; later actions and game judgements cannot rescue failure
no_down_rule: no non-repeat lane-zero DOWN in that cue scope; counts in denominator with null signed error
final_note_closure: if the last visible note has no DOWN, audit_end_us must be at or after its OD8 stable-native game expiry; reject a premature no_down claim
do_not: derive first action from judged note_id
count a null press as an osu MISS
derive primary success from later scored judgement
use future note timing as sensory input
